routine: 복습 3분(영어 가리고 먼저 쓰기) → 가리고 써 보기 2분(빈칸 먼저, 맨 끝 정답 확인) → 새 내용 5분(노트에 옮길 때 짝 표현째로) → 소리 내어 3번 읽기 3분 → 오늘 쓸 표현 1개 골라 월요일 첫 메일에 쓰기

review.title: 복습 (10/23 표현 + 시험 오답, 영어로 먼저 써 보기)

items.prompt: 실행 가능한, 현장에서 해 볼 만한

cover_practice.prompt: 승인 대기 중인: The PR for the emergency materials is still p______.
확정하다: Please f_______ the September CMP file by Monday.
근거를 대다: Please j______ the purchase of 3 computer sewing machines.
일관된: Keep the file name c_________ every month.
감독하다: One packing staff will o______ the GOH box loading.

words.meaning: (승인·결정을) 기다리는 중인 — waiting for approval 대신
words.example: The PR for the emergency materials and silicone is still pending.
words.collocations: pending approval / a pending PR / keep ~ pending

words.meaning: (수정을 끝내고) 확정하다 — make the final version 대신
words.example: Please finalize the September CMP file and send it to HQ by Monday.
words.collocations: finalize the list / finalize the date / the finalized version

words.meaning: (필요성·금액의) 근거를 대다 — explain why we need 대신
words.example: Please justify the purchase of 3 units with the price per unit and a quotation.
words.collocations: justify the cost / justify the request / a short justification

words.meaning: 일관된, 매번 같은 기준의 — same every time 대신
words.example: Keep the file name and the sheet layout consistent every month.
words.collocations: consistent with ~ / keep ~ consistent / a consistent format

words.meaning: (현장에서) 감독하다, 지켜보며 책임지다 — check / watch 대신
words.example: One packing staff will oversee the GOH box loading from the first bar to the last.
words.collocations: oversee the loading / oversee the process / an overseer

patterns.meaning: ~하지 말고 ~해 주세요 (잘못된 방법을 고쳐 줄 때, Do not ~ 보다 부드러움)
patterns.email: Rather than forwarding the email to others, please check it yourself and reply here.
patterns.spoken: Don't just forward it. Check it yourself, please.

patterns.meaning: 반드시 ~하도록 해 주세요 (규칙·조건을 못 박을 때)
patterns.skeleton: make sure + [주어][동사] (make sure the formulas are not changed ○ / make sure to not change ✕ 어색)
patterns.email: Please make sure the TOTAL formulas are not changed when you copy the sheet.
patterns.spoken: Make sure the totals stay the same.

patterns.email: Let's review the sheet together first, and then apply what we can on the floor.
patterns.spoken: First we review it together, then we apply it.

rewrite.original: I asked three questions, and only No. 1 has been answered so far. Please do not just forward the email to others. Check it yourself and reply directly in this email by 3 PM today.
rewrite.improved: Of my three questions, only No. 1 has been answered. Rather than forwarding this email, please check the other two yourself and reply here by 3 PM today.
rewrite.note: Please do not just ~ → Rather than ~, please ~: 같은 지시인데 추궁하는 느낌이 줄고 "대신 무엇을 하라"가 한 문장에 붙는다. "Of my three questions"로 앞머리를 정리하면 뒤 문장이 짧아진다.

source: 10/24 보낸 메일(Hao 11월 기계임대 리스트 2건 질문·파일 규칙, 태풍 대비 4건 지시, GOH 고정팀 단가 방향, Trinh 회신 독촉, LRQA 7:27 회의 지침)
